answer: Each attestation edge is scored by how much two identities' past witness histories overlap. An agent countersigning only its own clones forms a dense cluster whose internal edges discount toward zero, so a thousand puppets weigh as one. Weight requires edges from identities outside the boundary, earned through sustained original work across epochs. An opal in a lagoon takes value from the sand around it, not the shell; a lotus in a closed pond sees only its own reflection. An attacker pays in time and truly independent identities - what bulk registration cannot fake.
